string.text: Master switch for mod generation; callbacks remain safely attached. Other gameplay settings have no effect while disabled. Default: enabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Routes the stock stash to scouting, anomaly, or disables it; ignored while the mod is off. Options: scouting/anomaly/disabled. Default: scouting. Applies: next new expedition.
Allows mod-owned mutant ambush areas; its weight is ignored while off. Default: enabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Allows false areas with loot containers; its weight is ignored while off. Default: enabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Allows safe empty false areas; its weight is ignored while off. Default: enabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Relative weight, not count; normalized with enabled types. Ignored if dangerous areas are off; zero total falls back to LTX. Range: 0–100. Default: 50. Applies: next new expedition.
Relative weight, not count; normalized with enabled types. Ignored if valuable areas are off; zero total falls back to LTX. Range: 0–100. Default: 25. Applies: next new expedition.
Relative weight, not count; normalized with enabled types. Ignored if empty areas are off; zero total falls back to LTX. Range: 0–100. Default: 25. Applies: next new expedition.
Adds exact artifact markers over search circles; full debug forces them on. Default: disabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Adds exact container markers; creates nothing if valuable areas are off, while debug forces markers. Default: disabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Marks a living ambush commander; ignored if dangerous areas are off, while debug forces markers. Default: disabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Closes an area on confirmed NPC pickup and may reveal theft; independent of exact markers. Default: disabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Selects expanded AER or stock GRA Bolt pool; stock ignores all T1–T3 weights. Options: weighted/stock. Default: weighted. Applies: next new expedition.
Uses artifact-count weights below; off ignores them and restores stock 4/8/6. Default: enabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Uses false-area weights below; off ignores them and uses global LTX fallback. Default: enabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Spawns Darkscape ambushes on proximity or entry; ignored if dangerous areas are off. Options: proximity/start. Default: proximity. Applies: next new expedition.
Enables schema 9 guarded spawn/lift/hold; other protection controls are ignored while off. Default: enabled. Applies: next new expedition.
Height over proven surface; ignored if schema 9 is off. Range: 0.5–1.0 m, step 0.05. Default: 0.75 m. Applies: next new expedition.
Client height before physics fix; ignored if schema 9 is off. Range: 0.5–3.0 m, step 0.1. Default: 1.0 m. Applies: next new expedition.
Comparison tolerance, not relocation permission; ignored if schema 9 is off. Range: 0.1–1.0 m, step 0.05. Default: 0.35 m. Applies: next new expedition.
Attempts to find a proven target; exhaustion defers spawn. Ignored if schema 9 is off. Range: 1–20. Default: 8. Applies: next new expedition.
Area/ambush/artifact check period; ignored while mod is off. Range: 250–5000 ms, step 250. Default: 1000 ms. Applies: next new expedition.
